renameFamilies.rationale: Termination comes from the construction wall and the separately measured flow convergence controls; the implementation does not establish finite lattice height.
The code iterates reduced-product constraints and designer-intent evidence messages; it does not implement a general probabilistic belief-propagation algorithm.
The implementation performs demand-sliced monotone reachability and fact propagation without the distributive environment machinery claimed by the old family.
The published surface carries transform-catalog metadata and experiment scaffolding, not the objects, morphisms, identities, and composition required by the former theory name.
The implementation stores, plans, and aggregates cascade sections without a categorical site, covering families, or gluing laws.
The implementation exposes a bounded multiscale heuristic and does not establish a renormalization-group construction.
